🚨 Donkey of the Day goes to three men who beat a co-worker with a sock full of rocks after one decided to quit and the other two were fired. They allegedly assaulted him because he refused to quit his job. Now, what did their decisions have to do with him?
@cthagod breaks down why in today's #DOTD, powered by @msllegal. 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC
posts.summary: Criticizes coworkers for assaulting colleague over employment decisions
